Update 9/30: This post has now been updated with some additional accessories we have in our carts, and with the early fall Amazon Prime Day deals now flying, there are loads of tech accessories now seeing price drops right here and in our master roundup right here.

We are taking look at some of the iPhone 18 Pro accessories we are picking up for ourselves. If you ask me Apple’s AirTag 2 and a fresh set of AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are the best accessories you can buy for your new iPhone 18 Pro, but we are digging in a bit deeper here – chargers, MagSafe mounts, cases, wallets, and more. Check it all out below.

iPhone 18 Pro accessories

  • Chance – Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max
  • Ben – Apple TechWoven case
  • Michael – Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin – Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan – MagSafe Car Mount for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Fernando – Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra Slim Power Bank
  • Simon – Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin – Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand
  • Reinette – Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Some honorable mentions we love

If you want to charge your new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as fast as possible, you need a compatible charging block. In particular, you need one that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply — and Apple’s option is the best choice out there. It features a compact foldable design and can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple’s TechWoven case combines an attractive look, grippy feel, tactile anodized aluminum buttons, and a choice of richly deep colors – all coupled to the environmental creds of being made from 100% recycled polyester.

Anker’s compact 3-in-1 wireless charger powers all three from a single, portable accessory, with MagSafe-compatible Qi2 wireless charging for your iPhone. It folds down small enough to slip easily into a travel bag, making it a convenient way to leave multiple cables and adapters at home—or keep your entire Apple setup neatly organized on your nightstand or desk. It also happens to be nearly 35% off today, matching its lowest price ever on Amazon.

Apple’s FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe continues to be a must have iPhone accessory for minimalists. It comfortably stores 3-4 cards, whether that’s your ID, a couple of credit cards, or a key card, making it perfect for anyone who doesn’t want to carry a bulky wallet.

Whenever I’m driving, I want to have a safe, secure place to dock my iPhone. The ESR MagSafe Car Mount is my go-to product for that. You can magnetically attach iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, which clips conveniently on to your vehicle’s air vent. The MagSafe mount is a great way to keep your iPhone safe, but still visible and able to charge while you’re on the go.

I have always been a believer that MagSafe battery packs intended for active use with your iPhone should be as thin as possible. Baseus has just delivered my perfect MagSafe battery. The Picogo Air measures just 0.27 in and weighs 3.7oz. It packs a 5,000mAh battery, charges at 7.5W wirelessly and 22.5W when wired in. And the best part is that they already have a version that color matches the new Burgundy iPhone perfectly. This is how a MagSafe battery should be made, with thinness in mind.

If you travel often, you already know that keeping your tech bag clutter-free is half the battle. That’s why I’m always on the lookout for all-in-one charging gear. This Baseus travel adapter fits the bill nicely, supporting outlets in over 200 countries paired with a design that can power six devices at once. The real headliner for me, however, is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which allows you to top off your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while also delivering solid charging power for an iPad, MacBook, and more.

My guy Michael above chose what I would personally consider to be the best travel-ready foldable MagSafe charger out there, but I’m going to focus on two of my favorite desktop 3-in-1 models: the super sleek and ultra clean 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand with a gorgeous Space Black finish, and I really like Anker’s Smart Display 3-in-1 model, but the Satechi model is just too classy and beautifully understated to be beat.

After shelling out the money for the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max models, I typically look for the more affordable options on accessories rather than going with the most premium ones, and Spigen has a bunch of budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My top pick that comes well under the price of other brands is the clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case or its opaque multi-color counterparts, which are MagSafe options that allow for fast wireless charging. They also come with DuraClear blue resin-infused side TPU panels to resist yellowing, as well as impact-absorbing designs, not to mention the camera control button is covered by a thin TPU layer, too.
